1.0.13: One-click Update & restart now installs verified Windows updates silently without the manual setup wizard.
A protected pre-update database backup is created and validated before installation starts.
Minarva Biz closes for the upgrade and reopens automatically after the new version is installed.
1.0.14: Minarva Biz now checks for a newer Windows version when the dashboard opens and shows an update notification there.
The dashboard update card shows a clear What's new summary before the customer starts the update.
Software Updates now keeps the release changes visible while downloading and installing the new version.
Update & restart continues to verify the signed installer, create a protected backup, install silently and reopen Minarva Biz automatically.
1.0.15: Licensing and update verification now use the Minarva Biz Cloudflare edge directly, removing the Render dependency from customer-facing license operations.
License activation, validation, deactivation and trial registration now run through the same Cloudflare edge with scoped Supabase database calls.
The Windows installer now trusts the new Cloudflare-derived production signing authority used for activation certificates and signed updates.
1.0.16: Windows Customers now includes direct outstanding-balance collection with branch-scoped accounting entries.
Customer payments wait for native SQLite confirmation; failed saves can be retried without creating a duplicate payment.
An unresolved payment stays recoverable when navigating away from Customers and returning.
1.0.17: Existing Windows installations update through Software Updates > Update & Restart; no onsite reinstall is required.
A designated legacy demo customer's old business database is archived and verified before the new clean workspace opens.
Customer trial activation, device identity, licensing, and two backup copies are preserved; other customers' data is not reset.
1.0.18: Barcode labels now use their exact sticker paper size and keep the selling price visible instead of clipping it below the printable area.
Products > Print Barcode Label now includes a real in-app actual-size sticker preview, independent of unsupported Windows print preview.
Settings > Printer settings adds a compact (price-priority) or detailed label layout, alongside existing size, code mode, printer selection and copies controls.
1.0.19: Products & Inventory: enter different Size, Colour and Material combinations with separate piece quantities under one product; each variant gets its own SKU/barcode and inventory balance.
Each size/colour/material variant can be scanned and billed independently. The parent group is not itself a saleable stock item.

Barcode labels display Size, Colour and Material for each variant in addition to the product, scannable barcode and price. The default sticker copy count follows that variant’s available stock (up to 100).
